summary: Remove duplicated release and publication fixture contracts from producer tests.

consumerEvidence.incident: Release-note regressions exposed that tests duplicated standard-owned headings and labels; the current v3.2.2 release already resolves output labels through the selected standard, but the tests still contain avoidable prose and heading maintenance points.

acceptanceCriteria.outcome: Release-note tests derive group and section headings and visible detail labels from the selected release-notes standard instead of repeating its current prose.
Publication tests build their canonical ready body from the selected pull-request standard so section and field renames do not require a second hand-maintained fixture.
The release-note renderer, source URL schema, generated output, and publication validator behavior remain unchanged; the existing tests continue to cover those contracts.
The existing development and review profiles pass on one unchanged candidate snapshot.
